name: Wister Lim
hero_title_en: A thoughtful digital presence. Built to work.
hero_title_zh: 设计有质感，网站更有价值。
hero_description_en: I design and build distinctive websites, landing pages and practical automations that help businesses make a stronger first impression and connect with the right people.
hero_description_zh: 我设计与开发有辨识度的网站、落地页和实用的自动化流程，帮助品牌留下更好的第一印象，并与合适的潜在客户建立联系。
about_title_en: More than a website. A better way to connect.
about_title_zh: 不只是网站，更是让客户与你联系的桥梁。
about_body_en: I’m Wister, a Malaysia-based web designer and developer. I combine visual design with practical thinking — from websites and landing pages to lead capture and follow-up workflows. My background in quality control and process analysis shapes how I work: I care about the details, the user journey, and what happens after someone clicks.
about_body_zh: 我是 Wister，来自马来西亚的网页设计与开发者。我结合视觉设计与实际业务需求，制作网站、落地页、潜在客户收集及后续跟进流程。过去在质量管理与流程分析方面的经验，让我特别重视细节、访客体验，以及客户点击之后会发生什么。
